jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Evaluations (Design Generation)
jobs.snippet: Join Canva's Design Generation team as a Senior ML Engineer, building and maintaining evaluation systems for AI models that generate millions of designs monthly.
jobs.description:
## About the Role

Canva's Design Generation team builds the AI systems that power the creative capabilities of millions of users worldwide. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Evaluations, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining evaluation frameworks for generative AI models that produce designs at massive scale.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement robust evaluation pipelines for generative AI and diffusion models used in design creation
- Build automated testing infrastructure to measure model quality, safety, and performance at scale
- Collaborate with research scientists and ML engineers to define meaningful metrics that capture design quality
- Lead technical decisions on evaluation methodology, from offline benchmarks to online A/B testing
- Drive improvements to model quality by identifying failure modes and working with model teams to address them
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to Canva's ML engineering culture

## Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or related fields
- Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX)
- Experience with large-scale ML systems and distributed computing
- Familiarity with generative models (diffusion models, GANs, or similar)
- Experience designing evaluation systems for ML models
- Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, CI/CD, and code review

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, AWS, Kubernetes, Spark, dbt

## Benefits

- Equity (Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
- Flexible work from home or Canva campus (Sydney, Melbourne)
- Generous parental leave
- Wellness allowance and learning budget
- Annual Canva Create equity top-ups

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Content ML
jobs.snippet: Canva's Content ML team is seeking a Senior ML Engineer to build recommendation systems and personalisation models that surface the right content to the right users.
jobs.description:

The Content ML team at Canva is responsible for the machine learning systems that help users discover the right templates, elements, and assets. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design and build personalisation and recommendation infrastructure that shapes the creative experience for hundreds of millions of users.

## Responsibilities

- Build and ship end-to-end ML systems for content discovery, recommendation, and personalisation
- Own the full machine learning lifecycle: from feature engineering and model training to deployment and monitoring
- Develop real-time and batch ML pipelines that process large-scale user interaction data
- Collaborate closely with product managers and data scientists to identify high-impact ML opportunities
- Improve retrieval and ranking systems using embedding models, two-tower architectures, and other industry-standard approaches
- Maintain high engineering standards through code reviews, testing, and documentation

## Requirements

- 5+ years of ML engineering experience with a strong focus on recommendation systems or personalisation
- Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)
- Experience with large-scale distributed data processing (Spark, Flink, or similar)
- Solid understanding of embedding models, ANN search, and ranking algorithms
- Experience deploying low-latency ML models in production
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, GCP, BigQuery, Apache Spark, Feast, Vertex AI

## Benefits

- Remote-first within AU with periodic travel to Melbourne or Sydney campus
- Equity plan and competitive total compensation
- Health insurance, 16 weeks parental leave
- Annual learning & development budget

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Specialist Platform and Experience
jobs.snippet: Build and operate the ML platform that enables Canva's data scientists and ML engineers to ship AI features faster, including inference pipelines and embedding storage.
jobs.description:
## About the Role

The Specialist Platform and Experience team builds the internal ML platform that powers AI development across Canva. As a Senior ML Engineer on this team, you will design and build the infrastructure, tooling, and governance layers that allow product teams to ship AI-powered features reliably at scale.

Python, Kubernetes, GCP, Vertex AI, Kubeflow, Feast, Qdrant

## Benefits

- Hybrid work from Melbourne campus or remote across AU
- Equity (ESOP), competitive salary, health and wellbeing benefits

jobs.title: Data Scientist: AI and Machine Learning
jobs.snippet: CSIRO is hiring a Data Scientist to lead development of ML/AI/computer vision applications for geological characterisation using state-of-the-art methods.
jobs.description:
## About the Role

CSIRO — Australia's national science agency — is seeking a Data Scientist with expertise in AI and machine learning to join the Earth and Ecological Sciences team in Perth. You will develop and apply cutting-edge ML and computer vision solutions to geological characterisation problems, working at the intersection of AI research and real-world scientific applications.

## About the Business Unit

CSIRO's Mineral Resources division is a world leader in geoscience and mineral systems research. The AI and Machine Learning team applies deep learning and data science to transform how Australia discovers and characterises mineral resources, contributing directly to the nation's economic competitiveness and sustainable resource development.

## Responsibilities

- Lead development of machine learning and computer vision applications for geological data interpretation
- Apply deep learning techniques to analyse hyperspectral imaging, geochemical datasets, and drill-core imagery
- Design and implement scalable ML pipelines for processing large geoscientific datasets
- Collaborate with geoscientists, engineers, and industry partners to translate scientific problems into ML solutions
- Publish and present research findings at international conferences and in peer-reviewed journals
- Contribute to CSIRO's IP portfolio through innovation and patent development

## Requirements

- PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field
- Strong background in deep learning, computer vision, or geospatial data analysis
- Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)
- Experience with large-scale data processing and cloud computing (AWS or Azure)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team
- Eligible to work in Australia (AU/NZ citizen, PR, or temporary resident)

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, AWS, Docker, scikit-learn, OpenCV

## Benefits

- Salary: $95k–$115k + 15.4% superannuation
- Flexible working arrangements
- Access to world-class research infrastructure
- Generous parental leave (16 weeks primary carer)

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (AIPS CQ - NLP)

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning & Data Engineer

jobs.title: 2026 Technology Rotational Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: Westpac's Technology Rotational Graduate Program offers 2026 graduates exposure across data science, cybersecurity, application development, and service management.
jobs.description:
## About the Program

Westpac's 2026 Technology Rotational Graduate Program is a structured 2-year program designed to develop the next generation of technology leaders in Australia's banking sector. Graduates rotate across multiple technology domains, gaining broad exposure and deep skills.

## Program Overview

Starting February 2027, the program includes structured rotations that may encompass:
- **Data Science & Analytics**: Build predictive models, work on customer analytics, and explore responsible AI applications in banking
- **Application Development**: Contribute to software engineering projects across Westpac's digital banking platforms
- **Cyber Security**: Gain exposure to threat intelligence, security operations, and risk management
- **Service Management & Architecture**: Learn how large-scale enterprise technology is designed, operated, and governed

Rotations are available across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Gold Coast, and Perth.

## What You'll Do

- Work on real projects from day one, supported by a dedicated buddy and mentor
- Participate in structured learning programs and professional development workshops
- Attend graduate community events and networking sessions
- Complete an annual performance review and career planning process

## Requirements

- Completing a STEM degree (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related) by February 2027
- Australian or New Zealand citizen, or Australian Permanent Resident
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication and teamwork capabilities
- Genuine interest in technology and its application in financial services

## Benefits

- Salary: $80k–$90k per year + colleague banking benefits
- Flexible hybrid working across major Australian cities
- Generous parental leave, wellbeing support, and salary sacrificing

jobs.title: Technology (Data) Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: Westpac's specialist Technology (Data) Graduate Program is designed for STEM graduates who want to build deep technical expertise in data engineering, analytics, and AI.
jobs.description:

Westpac's Technology (Data) Graduate Program is a specialist pathway for graduates who are passionate about data and want to develop deep technical skills within Australia's oldest bank. - **Analytics Engineering**: Transforming raw data into clean, modelled datasets for business intelligence and ML use cases
- **Data Science**: Developing models for credit risk, customer lifetime value, churn prediction, and fraud detection
- **AI Governance**: Understanding responsible use of data and AI in a regulated financial services environment

## Duration and Location

- 2-year program commencing February 2027
- Based primarily in Sydney, with potential placement in Melbourne

## Requirements

- STEM degree (Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related) completing by February 2027
- Strong SQL skills and experience with at least one programming language (Python, R, or Scala)
- Australian citizenship, Permanent Residency, or New Zealand citizenship
- Demonstrated interest in data through academic projects, internships, or competitions
- GPA of at least 65% (credit average)

Azure Data Platform, Databricks, dbt, Python, SQL, Power BI

## Benefits

- AUD $80k–$90k starting salary + superannuation
- Structured mentoring and learning program
- Generous leave entitlements and flexible working

jobs.title: 2025/2026 Internship Program (Technology and Data)

jobs.title: Associate Machine Learning Engineer

jobs.title: AIGC算法实习生（Seed大模型）
jobs.snippet: 字节跳动Seed大模型团队招募AIGC算法实习生，聚焦大模型基础研究、工程架构及AI应用落地，面向2027届毕业生开放。
jobs.description:
## 关于岗位

字节跳动Seed团队是公司大模型研发核心团队，负责豆包大模型系列的基础研究与工程落地。作为AIGC算法实习生，你将深度参与大模型训练、优化及应用研发，直接接触业内最前沿的AI技术。

## 岗位职责

- 参与大语言模型（LLM）的预训练、指令微调（SFT）和强化学习（RLHF/RLAIF）研究
- 探索大模型在多模态理解与生成方向的算法创新（图文、视频、语音）
- 参与高质量训练数据构建、数据清洗和数据飞轮体系的建设
- 研究大模型推理加速、量化压缩等效率优化技术
- 协助开展学术研究并支持论文撰写与发表

## 岗位要求

- 2027届及以后毕业的硕士/博士在读生，计算机、数学、统计、电子工程等相关专业
- 扎实的深度学习理论基础（Transformer架构、注意力机制、归一化技术）
- 熟练掌握Python和PyTorch，具备高质量代码能力
- 有大模型训练/微调实战经验或顶会论文发表优先
- 每周可实习4天以上，实习期不少于3个月

## 技术栈

Python, PyTorch, CUDA, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Hugging Face

## 薪酬福利

- 日薪500元（高级方向可协商）
- 实习期满表现优异可获秋招直通卡
- 拎包入住北京实习公寓（部分方向）
- 提供GPU算力资源支持

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 百度发布史上最大规模暑期实习计划，超九成岗位与AI相关，大模型算法工程师方向涵盖LLM预训练、多模态、文心大模型等核心研究方向。

## 岗位职责
